description: Deletes one file from the draft of env: users keep getting it until neblla_promote "save" with that env ("pro" is what users have). In an app linked to its own repo, the delete is a commit on pre's branch. To rename: neblla_move_file.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_delete_file
title: Delete an app file
